$comment: Lists differences between code and the Figma library that are known gaps, not drift. Components with the same name pair on their own; entries here add exceptions, and "figma" names a Figma component whose name differs. Every gap names a GAPS.md section. Code wins every disagreement.

figmaWithoutCodeComponent.Search field: Inline in library-top-bar.tsx; there is no SearchField component yet.
figmaWithoutCodeComponent.Menu: The .ui-menu-popup surface class, used inside Base UI menus; not a component.
figmaWithoutCodeComponent.Menu item: The menuItemClassName() helper in src/components/ui/menu-item.ts; not a component.
figmaWithoutCodeComponent.Sidebar nav item: Inline ShellNavItem / ShellNavLink in library-shell.tsx; not exported.
figmaWithoutCodeComponent.Sidebar section header: Inline CollapsibleSection in library-shell.tsx; not exported.
figmaWithoutCodeComponent.Library card: A composition (LibraryItem) drawn for reference, not a reusable part.
figmaWithoutCodeComponent.List row: A composition (LibraryItem, list layout) drawn for reference, not a reusable part.

codeWithoutFigmaComponent.Icons: The icon catalogue story; icons are compared one by one under Icons.

codeOnlyTokens.--font-sans: Figma sets the family through text styles, not a variable.
